verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a 'Known Faces' report that compares an applicant's biometric media against prior applicants in the account database to flag repeat identity fraud attempts, directly matching the story of detecting the same face resurfacing under different names, corroborated by the general-introduction description of alerts for faces already seen in the verification flow. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of detection accuracy, no detail on document-level duplicate matching (only face-based) or false-positive handling.
